prompt:
People in many countries now spend most of their working day sitting at a desk, and much of their free time sitting as well.

What problems does this cause and what measures could be taken?
instruction_line: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
key_points: Problems and measures should be dealt with in separate paragraphs
At least two problems: physical discomfort, the long-term health effects of inactivity, lower mood and energy
Problems can be looked at from both the individual's and the workplace's perspective (lost productivity, absence)
Measures should match: short breaks at work, walking or cycling to work, accessible sports facilities in the neighbourhood, habits formed at school
The practicality of the suggestions should be explained — it should be stated who will do what
common_mistakes: Going into medical detail and making claims that require expert knowledge
Writing two separate lists without matching problems to measures
Suggesting only a single solution that relies on personal willpower
